rec.name: Multi-Level Mega Menu with Image Thumbnails (Desktop + Mobile Drawer)
rec.status: Design reference provided — build status not stated

what.text: A header navigation mega menu that supports deep category trees (4 or 5 levels). On desktop, a left rail lists top-level categories (some with a '+' expander, plus 'Brandneu', 'Sale', 'Renewed' and a bold 'Show all for men >' link). Next to it, columns show subcategories with round product thumbnails, and some entries have a '+' to drill down further. On mobile, it is a full-height drawer with a close (X) button. It lists the main categories as rounded cards with a thumbnail and a bold label, an 'All lights →' link, secondary links (Sustainability, About us, FAQ, Contact) as arrow rows, and a language selector at the bottom.

why.text: Visual thumbnails and clear hierarchy let shoppers recognise categories faster than with text-only lists. That lowers cognitive load and shortens the path to the right collection. Surfacing promo categories (New, Sale, Renewed) in the top rail draws attention to high-intent and discounted ranges. The deep tree keeps large catalogues browsable without crowding the page. On mobile, big tap targets, thumbnails and a clean list reduce mis-taps and bounce.

how.text: Build a custom header/navigation section in the theme that reads a Shopify menu (Online Store > Navigation) with up to 4–5 nested levels. Shopify's native menus allow at most 3 levels, so deeper levels need a workaround, e.g. a metaobject/metafield-driven menu structure or an app. Per link, add an image (collection image or a metafield/metaobject thumbnail). Desktop: a left column for level 1; on hover or click, render level 2 in a multi-column grid with round thumbnails; show a '+' on items that have children and expand level 3+ via a flyout or accordion. Add a 'View all' link for each top-level item. Mobile: a drawer with an X close button, level-1 items as image cards, tap-to-drill-down for deeper levels, secondary links and a language/market selector in the footer of the drawer. Design reference is in Figma (Lumiere Design | A/B Testing); Dopesnow.de is the live reference.

items: Menu depth: 4 or 5 levels (stated in ticket)
Thumbnail image per menu item (shown in screenshots)
Optional '+' expander on items with children
Mobile secondary links (About us, FAQ, Contact, etc.)
Language selector in the mobile drawer

dependencies.text: Shopify's native navigation is limited to 3 levels, so 4–5 levels need a custom data source (metaobjects/metafields) or a menu app; this is an inference, not stated in the ticket. Per-item images need a metafield or the collection image. Language selector assumes Shopify Markets/Translate & Adapt or a similar setup. Dopesnow.de is the live reference and Figma holds the design (links in ticket).

items: Click-through rate per menu level and item
Collection page entry rate from the menu
Search usage rate (expected to drop if navigation improves)
Bounce rate and exit rate on first pageview
Mobile conversion rate and revenue per session

images.caption: Desktop mega menu: left category rail (with '+' expanders and a 'Show all for men' link), plus subcategory columns with round product thumbnails and further '+' drill-downs.
Mobile menu drawer: image-led category cards, 'All lights' link, secondary link rows with arrows, and a language selector at the bottom.
